The '''Juvex systems''' were a group of [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] located in the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]] of<ref name="CSWE" /> the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region, within the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. They contained the [[Juvex system/Legends|Juvex system]], which was situated on the [[Senex-Juvex Loop]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]].<ref name="TEA" /> [[Bran Kemple]] was a small-time [[Smuggler/Legends|gunrunner]] in the Juvex systems before taking over a smuggling business on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="CotJ">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Juvex systems were first mentioned in [[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']], a [[1995]] novel authored by [[Barbara Hambly]].<ref name="CotJ" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], placed the Juvex system, and therefore at least a part of the Juvex systems, in grid square L-18.<ref name="TEA" />
